entries.source: this machine's own AVFoundation, in one binary with the port's own definitions renamed: tests/backports/host/avf-globals/run.sh reads Apple's symbol under the bare name and the port's under a charon_host_ prefix and compares the two, with a planted value and a clean control around it (macOS 27.0 build 26A428); read a second time from the shared cache of the iOS release that exports the name, read with tools/corpus/cache-value.lua as the value its exported symbol holds, which agrees on this name; and coordination/corpus/ledger/constant-values-AVFoundation.tsv, which holds the same measurement for this name on the same build; the release this object is placed in is the one that first EXPORTS the name, measured with tools/symbol-first-release.lua over the held cache ladder: 18.0, not the header's API_AVAILABLE
